newsitem.title: USA: Boeing board oks extended range 767-400.
newsitem.headline: Boeing board oks extended range 767-400.

text.p: Boeing Co said Tuesday its board formally approved production of the new 767-400 extended range airplane, the newest 767 stretch derivative.

Design and production planning of the 767-400ER was kicked off last month with the first order from Delta Air Lines Inc for 21 of the new jetliners. The 767-400ER is sized between the 767-300 and the 777-200.

It features a stretched fuselage, adding 21 feet in length and up to 20 percent more seats than the 767-300; aerodynamic improvements, including additional wing span; increased takeoff weight capability; and an all new main landing gear.
